extends Node
var p
func _ready() -> void:
	p = get_meta("viento_project")
	set_process(false)
func _probe(label: String) -> void:
	print("VIENTO_CLOCK_PROBE:" + JSON.stringify({"label": label, "clock": {"idleFrame": Engine.get_process_frames(), "physicsFrame": Engine.get_physics_frames()}, "used": p.host.get_ref().execution_budget.snapshot()}))
func _finish() -> void:
	p.host.get_ref().finish_project()
var steps := 0
func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	steps += 1
	p.write_state("physics", steps)
	_probe("physics-" + str(steps))
	if steps == 4:
		set_physics_process(false)
		call_deferred("_finish")
